description: This file defines the interface for the IpcModule class, which provides common IPC API functionalities for IPC modules within the Rialto client namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and member variables related to IPC channel management, event subscription, and RPC stub creation.

classes.name: IpcModule
classes.description: Defines common IPC API functionalities for IPC modules, including channel management, event subscription, and RPC stub creation.

methods.name: IpcModule
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IpcModule with a reference to an IIpcClient.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create RPC stubs for derived classes.

methods.name: subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Pure virtual method to subscribe to IPC events.

methods.name: attachChannel
methods.description: Attaches the IPC channel to the module.

methods.name: detachChannel
methods.description: Detaches the IPC channel from the module.

methods.name: reattachChannelIfRequired
methods.description: Reattaches the IPC channel if it is disconnected.
